adalers-grazing-delights.alt: Adaler's Grazing Delights logo: an orange pretzel above the business name and the line Artfully Arranged, Perfectly Shared

artworkReviewed.note: Replacement file, read at full size and at 4x on the band under the wordmark. The first file supplied had a line of contact details there; in this one the rule runs straight into the tagline 'Artfully Arranged, Perfectly Shared' and that line is gone. No phone number, email or address is set into the artwork. The numbers themselves are deliberately not quoted here: this file is served publicly at /data/, so writing them down to record their removal would republish them.
